props.markdown: The hour hand needs a gear that turns 12 times slower than the small gear of 10 teeth.

props.stem: How many teeth would that gear need?

feedback.correct: Yes, it takes 120 teeth. The small gear makes 12 turns of 10 teeth each. Look how large that gear is next to the clock.
feedback.incorrect: It takes 120 teeth. The small gear makes 12 turns of 10 teeth each. Look how large that gear is next to the clock.

misconceptions.feedback: That is the number of turns of the small gear. Each turn moves 10 teeth, so the gear needs 120. Look how large it is next to the clock.
That would be 12 times slower than the gear of 30. From the small gear of 10, it takes 120. Look how large it is next to the clock.

props.title: The small gear and a large gear, with the outline of the clock
props.textAlternative: **Text version.** The small gear of 10 teeth and the gear of 30, with the outline of the clock drawn as a dashed circle around the small gear. Once the question is answered, the large gear grows to 120 teeth: it reaches far beyond the outline of the clock.

events.description: Once the learner has answered, the large gear grows to 120 teeth.
